test_case_2_unknowns.description: Deliberately NOT a realistic or balanced payroll batch. Its only purpose is to verify the script correctly detects and flags unknowns instead of silently guessing or dropping data. Do not assert a balanced total for this case.

expected_flags.reason: Not present in the department code -> name mapping table
expected_flags.required_behavior: Output must show 'DEPT 99 (name not confirmed)' as a placeholder, clearly highlighted, and must NOT invent a department name.

expected_flags.label: Mystery Allowance
